acceptanceCriteria: On darwin, a lease Check under the writer lock does work independent of ticket count when the store exceeds the regular-file descriptor budget, shown by a maintained test or measurement at a budget below the store's file count.
Changes to over-budget files are still detected at least as strongly as the stat-tuple fallback of V1-0841.
The agent-leases spec's descriptor-budget paragraph no longer records the locked-scan limitation, or records the accepted replacement bound.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin, 2026-10-05, branch claude/rc2-darwin-guard-fds (V1-0841 fix). The V1-0841 fix tracks regular files beyond a process-wide kqueue descriptor budget (half the soft RLIMIT_NOFILE) by an lstat tuple, and vnodeWatch.changed re-lstats every over-budget file on each Check. Lease commits call Check while holding the writer lock (internal/tasks/store/lease_write.go around lines 419 and 462), so once a store exceeds the budget each commit performs two lstat sweeps proportional to the overflow file count under the lock. CAL-V0-026 requires locked work not to grow with ticket count. Expected: locked Check is O(1) in store size. Actual: O(overflow files) beyond the budget; within the budget unchanged. Before V1-0841 the same store refused with too many open files, so this is a bounded degradation, not a regression from a working state. Found by independent Codex review of commit b7094faf. Candidate directions: sweep before taking the lock and only poll kqueue under it, rely on directory events for atomic-rename writes, or raise the budget. Follows V1-0841.
title: Darwin change guard re-stats over-budget files under the lease writer lock
